response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned Staff-level engineer with a strong background in building scalable systems on the cloud using TypeScript. His most recent role at re:cinq, focused on AI-agent infrastructure, MCP, and agentic workflows, aligns directly with the core responsibilities of this position. While he lacks the requested 8+ years of specific AI experience, his deep software engineering expertise combined with this recent, highly relevant pivot makes him a compelling candidate worth exploring in an interview to determine the depth of his GenAI knowledge.
strengths: Direct experience with AI-agent infrastructure and agentic workflows in his current role.
Extensive Staff-level engineering experience across multiple domains, including cloud (AWS), microservices, and data platforms.
Proven expertise in TypeScript, one of the primary languages required for the role.
concerns: Lacks the required 8+ years of dedicated experience in production AI solutions; his AI focus appears very recent.
No explicit mention of key technologies like vector databases or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
The start date for his most relevant role is listed in the future (April 2025), which requires immediate clarification.
